Highlight.js 11.9.0, bundled locally so application code highlighting does not
depend on a third-party script host at runtime. BSD 3-Clause; see LICENSE.

Upstream release: https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js/releases/tag/11.9.0
Distributed build: https://github.com/highlightjs/cdn-release/tree/11.9.0/build
Files: highlight.min.js and styles/atom-one-dark.min.css (copied unchanged).
If highlighting cannot initialize, app.js renders escaped plain code instead.
